Installation

This page explains how to install the toolkit and verify that your environment is ready. You will need node version 18 or later.

Using a package manager

npm install --save docskit
# or
yarn add docskit
Note: Global installs are supported but not recommended for projects with multiple contributors.

Configuration options

OptionTypeDefaultDescription
portnumber3000Port for the dev server
openbooleanfalseOpen the browser on start
basestring"/"Public base path of the site
Warning: Changing base after the first deployment may break existing links. Press Ctrl+C to stop the server.

Verify the install

Run the following command and confirm the version number appears in your terminal output.

$ docskit --version
docskit/2.4.1 linux-x64 node-v20.11.0

If you see an error, consult the troubleshooting guide or open an issue with the output of docskit doctor.
